notes: Marketed simply as "FX6" (part of Sony's Cinema Line); official SKU is ILME-FX6V (kit kit kit also sold as PXW-FX6/ILME-FX6VK/ILME-FX6T/ILME-FX6TK variants by region/bundle). Sony's own product/spec pages (sony.com, pro.sony) returned 403/blocked errors during research, so data is drawn from B&H's detailed spec table, cross-checked against Sony's own FX6 service manual (mirrored on manualslib.com) and other manual excerpts. Confirmed the FX6 has NO genlock connector (unlike the FX9) — omitted intentionally, not missed. B&H's spec table also lists two more minor connectors — a separate 1/8"(3.5mm) "Control" jack and a "Proprietary" connector (almost certainly the handle/grip-unit interface) — that could not be reliably identified/labeled from available documentation, so they were left out rather than guessed; only the more clearly LANC-style "Remote" 2.5mm jack is included. HDMI/SDI/USB-C grades are stated explicitly by the source; the Multi/Micro USB terminal's speed is not stated (commonly USB 2.0 on Sony camera Multi terminals) so no grade was assigned. Body is a handheld/shoulder cinema camera, not rack-mountable.
